# Squishy Lab

> Squishy Lab is a free online 3D squishy simulator. Press, hold and drag cute virtual squishies in your browser, personalize their look, and download your creation as a PNG.

## Official website

- [Play Squishy Lab](https://www.squishylab.fun/): the interactive playground.
- [About and instructions](https://www.squishylab.fun/guide/): features, browser requirements and how to play.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.squishylab.fun/guide/#faq): sound, personalization and optional AI editing.
- [Source and documentation](https://github.com/Daniele-Cangi/squishy-lab): the open-source project and setup documentation.

## Features and limits

- The collection has 15 entries: Mochi, Butter, Strawberry bar, Strawberry face, Jelly cube, Chocolate, Banana, Cat, Cheese, Peanut, Jelly Drop, Sugar Drop, Kitty Paw, Sleepy Capybara and Glazed Donut.
- Mouse, touch and keyboard interaction; longer holds deepen the squeeze. Fullscreen is available on desktop and mobile.
- Soft touch, glitter and clear finishes; five face expressions; custom lettering in four fonts with a text color picker.
- Recorded gel and crunchy sound textures. Audio starts after interaction and can be muted.
- Free use without an account or installation. The interactive playground requires JavaScript and WebGL 2.
- Optional AI edits adjust supported material properties such as color, softness and recovery. AI does not create arbitrary meshes or shapes.
- AI allows three verified requests per public IP in a rolling 24-hour window. Devices sharing an IP share the allowance. The other playground features do not use AI.

This file summarizes the public site. It is not an API endpoint or a guarantee of inclusion in search results.
